turns.prompt_text: what does pulse oxygen level represent
turns.response_html: Pulse oxygen level, or oxygen saturation, measures the percentage of oxygen-carrying hemoglobin in your red blood cells. A normal reading indicates that your heart and lungs are effectively supplying oxygen to your body.
VO2 max, or maximal oxygen consumption, is the maximum rate of oxygen your body can use during intense exercise. It is a key indicator of cardiovascular fitness and aerobic endurance.
